|-|Cursed Parade=
[[File:Cursed Parade.png|thumb|300x300px|<i>"Are you the strongest because you're Satoru Gojo? Or are you Satoru Gojo because you're the strongest?"</i>]]
===<span style="font-size: 200%;">Cursed Parade</span>===
Introduced in [[Update Log#Update_6.5_-_Jujutsu_Kaisen_Update_Part_2|Update 6: Part 2]], '''Cursed Parade''' is a challenging dungeon where you and up to 6 others have to protect the academy from the sudden surge of curses. Will you be able to exorcise them?

==Information==
* This dungeon does not hold back, so make sure to bring heavy damage dealers and air support!

* On wave 20, your final challenge is to defeat the [[Getu|Getu Boss]]!

==Keys==
* Key (Cursed Parade): {{Gems|200}} or {{Gold|2000}}
:* Gives you the normal amount of rewards
* Shiny Key (Cursed Parade): {{Robux|99}}
:* Doubles the chance of getting a {{Rarity|Secret}} unit

|-|Cursed Womb=
[[File:Cursed Womb.png|thumb|300x300px|<i>"Throughout heaven and earth, he alone is the honored one."</i>]]
===<span style="font-size: 200%;">Cursed Womb</span>===
Introduced in [[Update Log#Update_6.5_-_Jujutsu_Kaisen_Update_Part_2|Update 6: Part 2]], '''Cursed Womb''' is a dungeon that hides the remains of a very powerful curse; the strongest even. What lengths are you willing to go to retrieve these remains?

==Information==
* This dungeon is not the hardest, but it's never good to be cocky. Make sure to bring a buddy!

* On wave 15, defeating the Finger Bearer boss will reward you with one of the strongest curses' lost finger

==Requirement==
To enter the dungeon, you must defeat a Womb Curse in '''Cursed Academy''' infinite and obtain their key
* x1 Key (Cursed Womb)

==Rewards==
* x1 {{Item|Cursed Finger}}
__NOEDITSECTION____NOTOC__
